description: Create, update or destroy a reverse_proxy frontend entry in Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: add_content_type_header
parameters.description: Whether to add the content type header or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The reference name of the network/interface_address object. Default: "REF_DefaultInternalAddress"

parameters.name: allowed_networks
parameters.description: A list of reference names for the allowed networks. Default: ["REF_NetworkAny"]

parameters.name: certificate
parameters.description: The reference name of the ca/host_key_cert object. Default: ""

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: An optional comment to add to the object. Default: ""

parameters.name: disable_compression
parameters.description: Whether to enable the compression. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: A list of domain names for the frontend object.

parameters.name: exceptions
parameters.description: A list of exception ref names (reverse_proxy/exception). Default: []

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: htmlrewrite
parameters.description: Whether to enable HTML rewrite or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: htmlrewrite_cookies
parameters.description: Whether to enable HTML rewrite cookie or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: implicitredirect
parameters.description: Whether to enable implicit redirection or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: lbmethod
parameters.description: Which loadbalancer method should be used. Choices: "" "bybusyness" ← (default) "bytraffic" "byrequests"

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: A list of location ref names (reverse_proxy/location). Default: []

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The frontend http port. Default: 80

parameters.name: preservehost
parameters.description: Whether to preserve host header. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The reference string of the reverse_proxy/profile. Default: ""

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Whether to activate the frontend entry or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which protocol should be used. Choices: "http" ← (default) "https"

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: xheaders
parameters.description: Whether to pass the host header or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Create utm proxy_frontend
  community.general.utm_proxy_frontend:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestFrontendEntry
    host: REF_OBJECT_STRING
    state: present

- name: Remove utm proxy_frontend
  community.general.utm_proxy_frontend:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestFrontendEntry
    state: absent

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The utm object that was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: _locked
return_values.description: Whether or not the object is currently locked. Returned: success

return_values.name: _ref
return_values.description: The reference name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: _type
return_values.description: The type of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: add_content_type_header
return_values.description: Whether to add the content type header. Returned: success

return_values.name: address
return_values.description: The reference name of the address. Returned: success

return_values.name: allowed_networks
return_values.description: List of reference names of networks associated. Returned: success

return_values.name: certificate
return_values.description: Reference name of certificate (ca/host_key_cert). Returned: success

return_values.name: comment
return_values.description: The comment string. Returned: success

return_values.name: disable_compression
return_values.description: State of compression support. Returned: success

return_values.name: domain
return_values.description: List of hostnames. Returned: success

return_values.name: exceptions
return_values.description: List of associated proxy exceptions. Returned: success

return_values.name: htmlrewrite
return_values.description: State of HTML rewrite. Returned: success

return_values.name: htmlrewrite_cookies
return_values.description: Whether the HTML rewrite cookie is set. Returned: success

return_values.name: implicitredirect
return_values.description: Whether to use implicit redirection. Returned: success

return_values.name: lbmethod
return_values.description: The method of loadbalancer to use. Returned: success

return_values.name: locations
return_values.description: The reference names of reverse_proxy/locations associated with the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: The port of the frontend connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: preservehost
return_values.description: Preserve host header. Returned: success

return_values.name: profile
return_values.description: The associated reverse_proxy/profile. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Whether the frontend object is active or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The connection type. Returned: success

return_values.name: xheaders
return_values.description: The xheaders state. Returned: success
